Author: AlexFlipnote
Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
New optional setting (Social): right-click a player in the world, or on the target / focus target bar, to add them to your blacklist without waiting for them to talk in chat.
Sweep all districts now starts from where you are: if you are already near an aetheryte in a district's gateway city or in the district itself, that district is swept first without teleporting, saving gil.
Fixed "Add to Blacklist" and "Invite to Party" in the Nearby window doing nothing.
